  == The Steam Cavern
  ~ That evening Munmu rides alone into the hills east of Surabol. His uncle never showed him the path. He finds it anyway, the way sons find what uncles hid on pur
  ~ He strips at the rock lip as if obeying an order nobody ever gave him in writing, and steps into water so black it reflects nothing.
  ~ Crimson leaves his shoulders the way a soldier sheds a campaign coat. Steam takes the rest. He does not look up until the water has him.

  == Thirty Winters On
  ~ They walk on. Thirty years later, in 698, the boy will raise a kingdom called Balhae on those three words, and the shard will still be warm.
  ~ His capital will be a stamped grid of halls on the Mudanjiang. Lotus tiles. A stone lantern. Nobody there will need telling what the old country was called.
  ~ So this story ends with two kings under one sky, each sure the sky meant him. In the south, a dead king lies under a rock in the sea, listening for the ones wit
  ~ Dae Joyoung keeps walking north, one hand on the gold under his coat.
